prompt: How old would James Logan have been when the estate of his descendent donated Neshaminy State Park land to the Commonwealth of Pennsylvania?
answer: James Logan was born on October 20, 1674. When his descendant Robert Logan’s estate donated the land in 1956, James Logan would have been **281 or 282 years old**—turning **282** that October. Of course, Logan himself had died in 1751.
